MOVE_LAST_RESPECTS.description: This move deals more damage  for each defeated ally.

MOVE_LUMINA_CRASH.name: Lumina Crash
MOVE_LUMINA_CRASH.description: A mind-affecting light  harshly lowers Sp. Def.

MOVE_ORDER_UP.name: Order Up
MOVE_ORDER_UP.description: Boosts a user's stats  depending on Tatsugiri.

MOVE_JET_PUNCH.name: Jet Punch
MOVE_JET_PUNCH.description: A punch is thrown at blinding  speed to strike first.

MOVE_SPICY_EXTRACT.name: Spicy Extract
MOVE_SPICY_EXTRACT.description: Sharply ups target's Attack,  harshly lowers its Defense.

MOVE_SPIN_OUT.name: Spin Out
MOVE_SPIN_OUT.description: Furiously strains its legs.  Harshly lowers user's Speed.

MOVE_POPULATION_BOMB.name: Population Bomb
MOVE_POPULATION_BOMB.description: The user's fellows hit one  to ten times in a row.

MOVE_ICE_SPINNER.name: Ice Spinner
MOVE_ICE_SPINNER.description: Ice-covered feet hit a foe  and destroy the terrain.

MOVE_GLAIVE_RUSH.name: Glaive Rush
MOVE_GLAIVE_RUSH.description: Foe attacks next turn can't  miss and do double damage.

MOVE_REVIVAL_BLESSING.name: Revival Blessing
MOVE_REVIVAL_BLESSING.description: Revives a fainted party {PKMN}  and restores half of its HP.

MOVE_SALT_CURE.name: Salt Cure
MOVE_SALT_CURE.description: Hurts foe every turn. Double  damage to Steel and Water.

MOVE_TRIPLE_DIVE.name: Triple Dive
MOVE_TRIPLE_DIVE.description: Hits target with splashes  of water 3 times in a row.

MOVE_MORTAL_SPIN.name: Mortal Spin
MOVE_MORTAL_SPIN.description: Erases trap moves and Leech  Seed. Poisons adjacent foes.

MOVE_DOODLE.name: Doodle
MOVE_DOODLE.description: Changes user's and ally's  Ability into the target's.

MOVE_FILLET_AWAY.name: Fillet Away
MOVE_FILLET_AWAY.description: Sharply boosts offenses and  Speed by using its own HP.

MOVE_KOWTOW_CLEAVE.name: Kowtow Cleave
MOVE_KOWTOW_CLEAVE.description: User slashes the foe after  kowtowing. It never misses.

MOVE_FLOWER_TRICK.name: Flower Trick
MOVE_FLOWER_TRICK.description: Rigged bouquet. Always gets  a critical hit, never missing.

MOVE_TORCH_SONG.name: Torch Song
MOVE_TORCH_SONG.description: Flames scorch the target.  Boosts the user's Sp. Atk.

MOVE_AQUA_STEP.name: Aqua Step
MOVE_AQUA_STEP.description: Hits with light, fluid dance  steps. Ups the user's Speed.

MOVE_RAGING_BULL.name: Raging Bull
MOVE_RAGING_BULL.description: Tackle that breaks barriers.  User's form determines type.

MOVE_MAKE_IT_RAIN.name: Make It Rain
MOVE_MAKE_IT_RAIN.description: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk.  Money is recovered after.

MOVE_RUINATION.name: Ruination
MOVE_RUINATION.description: Summons a ruinous disaster  and cuts half the foe's HP.

MOVE_COLLISION_COURSE.name: Collision Course
MOVE_COLLISION_COURSE.description: Prehistoric explosion that's  stronger if super effective.

MOVE_ELECTRO_DRIFT.name: Electro Drift
MOVE_ELECTRO_DRIFT.description: Futuristic electricity. It's  stronger if super effective.

MOVE_SHED_TAIL.name: Shed Tail
MOVE_SHED_TAIL.description: Creates a Substitute for  itself before switching out.

MOVE_CHILLY_RECEPTION.name: Chilly Reception
MOVE_CHILLY_RECEPTION.description: Bad joke summons hailstorm.  The user also switches out.

MOVE_TIDY_UP.name: Tidy Up
MOVE_TIDY_UP.description: User tidies up hazards and  raises its Attack and Speed.

MOVE_SNOWSCAPE.name: Snowscape
MOVE_SNOWSCAPE.description: Summons a hailstorm that  strikes every turn.

MOVE_POUNCE.name: Pounce
MOVE_POUNCE.description: The user pounces on the foe,  lowering its Speed.

MOVE_TRAILBLAZE.name: Trailblaze
MOVE_TRAILBLAZE.description: The user attacks suddenly,  raising its Speed.

MOVE_CHILLING_WATER.name: Chilling Water
MOVE_CHILLING_WATER.description: A shower with ice-cold water  lowers the target's Attack.

MOVE_HYPER_DRILL.name: Hyper Drill
MOVE_HYPER_DRILL.description: A spinning pointed part  bypasses a foe's Protect.

MOVE_TWIN_BEAM.name: Twin Beam
MOVE_TWIN_BEAM.description: Mystical eye-beams that hit  the target twice in a row.

MOVE_RAGE_FIST.name: Rage Fist
MOVE_RAGE_FIST.description: The more the user has been  hit, the stronger the move.

MOVE_ARMOR_CANNON.name: Armor Cannon
MOVE_ARMOR_CANNON.description: A strong attack but lowers  the defensive stats.

MOVE_BITTER_BLADE.name: Bitter Blade
MOVE_BITTER_BLADE.description: An attack that absorbs  half the damage inflicted.

MOVE_DOUBLE_SHOCK.name: Double Shock
MOVE_DOUBLE_SHOCK.description: Discharges all electricity,  losing the Electric type.

MOVE_GIGATON_HAMMER.name: Gigaton Hammer
MOVE_GIGATON_HAMMER.description: Swings a huge hammer. Can't  be used twice in a row.

MOVE_COMEUPPANCE.name: Comeuppance
MOVE_COMEUPPANCE.description: Retaliates strongly against  who last hurt the user.

MOVE_AQUA_CUTTER.name: Aqua Cutter
MOVE_AQUA_CUTTER.description: Pressurized water cut with a  high critical-hit ratio.

MOVE_PSYBLADE.name: Psyblade
MOVE_PSYBLADE.description: This move's power increases  when on Electric Terrain.

MOVE_HYDRO_STEAM.name: Hydro Steam
MOVE_HYDRO_STEAM.description: This move's power increases  under harsh sunlight.

MOVE_BLOOD_MOON.name: Blood Moon
MOVE_BLOOD_MOON.description: Unleashes the blood moon.  Can't be used twice in a row.

MOVE_MATCHA_GOTCHA.name: Matcha Gotcha
MOVE_MATCHA_GOTCHA.description: Absorbs half the damage  inflicted. May cause a burn.

MOVE_SYRUP_BOMB.name: Syrup Bomb
MOVE_SYRUP_BOMB.description: Lowers the foe's speed  each turn for 3 turns.

MOVE_IVY_CUDGEL.name: Ivy Cudgel
MOVE_IVY_CUDGEL.description: Type changes with held mask.  High critical-hit ratio.

MOVE_ELECTRO_SHOT.name: Electro Shot
MOVE_ELECTRO_SHOT.description: Gathers electricity, then  fires a high-voltage shot.

MOVE_TERA_STARSTORM.name: Tera Starstorm
MOVE_TERA_STARSTORM.description: In Terapagos's Stellar  Form, it hits all foes.

MOVE_FICKLE_BEAM.name: Fickle Beam
MOVE_FICKLE_BEAM.description: Shoots a beam of light.  Sometimes twice as strong.

MOVE_BURNING_BULWARK.name: Burning Bulwark
MOVE_BURNING_BULWARK.description: Evades attack, and burns  the foe if struck.

MOVE_THUNDERCLAP.name: Thunderclap
MOVE_THUNDERCLAP.description: Strikes first if the foe  is preparing an attack.

MOVE_MIGHTY_CLEAVE.name: Mighty Cleave
MOVE_MIGHTY_CLEAVE.description: An attack that hits foes  using moves like Protect.

MOVE_TACHYON_CUTTER.name: Tachyon Cutter
MOVE_TACHYON_CUTTER.description: Launches particle blades at  the target. Strikes twice.

MOVE_HARD_PRESS.name: Hard Press
MOVE_HARD_PRESS.description: The higher the foe's HP  the more damage caused.

MOVE_DRAGON_CHEER.name: Dragon Cheer
MOVE_DRAGON_CHEER.description: Increases allies' critical hit  ratio, especially if Dragons.

MOVE_ALLURING_VOICE.name: Alluring Voice
MOVE_ALLURING_VOICE.description: Confuses foe if its stats  were boosted this turn.

MOVE_TEMPER_FLARE.name: Temper Flare
MOVE_TEMPER_FLARE.description: A desperation attack. Power  doubles if last move failed.

MOVE_SUPERCELL_SLAM.name: Supercell Slam
MOVE_SUPERCELL_SLAM.description: An electrified slam. If it  misses, the user is hurt.

MOVE_PSYCHIC_NOISE.name: Psychic Noise
MOVE_PSYCHIC_NOISE.description: Sound waves that damage and  prevent healing for 2 turns.

MOVE_UPPER_HAND.name: Upper Hand
MOVE_UPPER_HAND.description: Makes the target flinch if  readying a priority move.

MOVE_MALIGNANT_CHAIN.name: Malignant Chain
MOVE_MALIGNANT_CHAIN.description: A corrosive chain attack  that may badly poison.

MOVE_10000000_VOLT_THUNDERBOLT.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
MOVE_10000000_VOLT_THUNDERBOLT.description: Cap Pikachu unleashes jolt.  High critical-hit ratio.

MOVE_MAX_GUARD.name: Max Guard
MOVE_MAX_GUARD.description: Evades attack, but may fail  if used in succession.
